objective: Design and independently review one frozen toy validation protocol under certificate contract 1.0.0-review; authorize no implementation or experiment. Final batch under the three-batch campaign budget.

tasks.title: Design frozen toy validation protocol under contract 1.0.0-review

handoff.objective: Produce one frozen review-only toy validation protocol under certificate contract 1.0.0-review that pins a public fixture, sealed empty-or-pilot schedule template, independent verifier artifact hash binding, and group-operation type vocabulary, or return a scoped no-go at the first unsatisfied pinning obligation.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a separately reviewable toy protocol can be fully specified without authorizing implementation.
constraints: Review-only protocol design; do not implement or execute any experiment.
Bind exactly to certificate contract schema version 1.0.0-review.
Pin a concrete public toy fixture description with complete bytes hashable and checkable group parameters.
Include a sealed empty-or-pilot schedule template with seeds, retry forest, strata, alphas, and resource ownership placeholders consistent with the contract.
Pin an independent verifier identity and artifact SHA-256 binding (hash of the declared verifier artifact path or sealed stub digest); do not write executable verifier code outside write_scope.
Freeze an explicit group-operation type vocabulary.
Make no attack improvement, ECDLP lower bound, cryptographic-scale, or breakthrough claim.
If a complete protocol cannot be pinned, identify the first failed obligation in a scoped no-go; do not assert universal impossibility.
Write only within the assigned scope; preserve unrelated dirty paths.
Record inference per DEC-20260724-007; do not claim equivalence to research-sol-max.
completion_gate: Both exact review-only artifacts exist and bind relied-upon inputs.
The protocol pins fixture, schedule template, verifier hash binding, and group-operation vocabulary, or names the first failed obligation in a scoped no-go.
Exactly one recommended next action is recorded and no implementation or experiment is authorized.
handoff.return_format: YAML protocol plus Markdown binding derivation or scoped no-go.

tasks.title: Archive the toy protocol design package

handoff.objective: Commit exactly the toy protocol design artifacts before independent review.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the reviewer receives an immutable protocol package.
constraints: Run alone, stage only declared paths, preserve unrelated dirty files, and stop on integrity failure.
completion_gate: The post-commit verifier accepts exact paths, parent, message IDs, reachability, and SHA-256 values.

tasks.title: Independently review the toy validation protocol

handoff.objective: Independently falsify fixture completeness, schedule seal consistency with contract 1.0.0-review, verifier hash binding, group-operation vocabulary, and claim boundaries.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the protocol is concrete enough for a later separately budgeted toy experiment design decision.
constraints: Use an independent non-originating session with inference per DEC-20260724-007.
Validate snapshot and producer inference before interpretation.
Authorize no implementation, experiment, attack claim, or cryptographic inference.
Verdict must be PASS, REVISE, or FAIL with exact non-breakthrough boundaries.
completion_gate: Both reports bind the verified snapshot and reviewed inputs.
The report returns PASS, REVISE, or FAIL with exact non-breakthrough boundaries.
The review records an independent non-originating session and exactly one recommended action.
handoff.return_format: Independent YAML verdict plus Markdown adversarial reconstruction.

tasks.title: Archive BATCH-003 review and checkpoint or pause the goal

handoff.objective: Commit the independent BATCH-003 review, scoped evidence, Coordinator decision, and goal checkpoint; apply the three-batch pause condition if completion criteria remain unmet.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the toy protocol is durable and whether the campaign must pause under budget.
inputs: the two exact TASK-20260724-303 review artifacts
constraints: Run alone, validate independence and snapshot binding, stage only declared paths, fill knowledge promotion, and preserve exact claim boundaries.
If no completion criterion is met after this third batch, mark GOAL-ECDLP-001 paused under the declared three-batch budget pause condition with exactly one next action for a future campaign.
Stop on any archive verification failure.
completion_gate: Review integrity and exact claim boundaries pass.
Evidence and decision records state protocol disposition and campaign active/paused status.
The goal retains exactly one next action and the post-commit verifier accepts the archive.
handoff.return_format: Coordinator ledger archive receipt JSON plus immutable YAML records.
